title: NPDev job record (npdev-job.v1)
description: One file per long-running process at <BuildRoot>/jobs/<jobId>.json, written by whoever starts it (run_digest.py, the Manager's run recorder, npdev eval/gpu-check). Read by `npdev jobs`, the Manager's Activity > Tasks screen and the static jobs board. Writers rewrite the whole file atomically (write <id>.json.tmp, then rename).

jobId.description: <UTC stamp>-<label>, same stem as the digest log.

title.description: What a person would call it: 'All quality gates', 'Rebuild WmsOffice'. Comes from the digest family's `title` in scripts/policy/output-digest-policy.json.

argv.description: The command as typed, already passed through redaction-rules.json.

pid.description: The launched process. On Windows also the root of its job object.

status.description: 'lost' = record says running but the pid is gone and no end was written (the writer died).

heartbeatAt.description: Rewritten about every 15 s while running; a stale heartbeat plus a dead writer means 'lost'.

transcriptPath.description: The session's .jsonl, so the board can show the prompt that led here.

promptExcerpt.description: Filled lazily by the board from the transcript, never by the writer.

actions.description: What this job supports. A job started by another machine or CI offers openLog only.

writerPid.description: The process that writes this record (run_digest.py). `lost` is decided from it: a running record whose writer is gone and whose heartbeat is older than 60 s.
